EDA-08Missing Length Validation For Keccak Commitment
Assetapi/proxy/server/handlers_cert.go
StatusResolved: See Resolution
RatingSeverity: LowImpact: LowLikelihood: Low
<|det|>title [68, 255, 178, 273]<|/det|>Description <|det|>text [66, 295, 931, 325]<|/det|>The handleGetOPKeccakCommitment() function does not validate that the decoded Keccak commitment is exactly 32 bytes, allowing malformed requests to be processed until they fail at a later stage. <|det|>text [66, 338, 931, 381]<|/det|>The function decodes the hex-encoded Keccak commitment from the request path but does not verify its length before passing it to the storage layer. Keccak256 hashes are always 32 bytes, and the system expects this invariant to hold throughout the processing pipeline. <|det|>text [70, 388, 593, 404]<|/det|>api/proxy/server/handlers_cert.go:handleGetOPKeccakCommitment() <|det|>text [73, 407, 752, 523]<|/det|>func (svr =Server) handleGetOPKeccakCommitment(% http.ResponderError, r =http.Request) error { keccakCommittext, ok := mux.Vars(r)[RoutingVarnameKeccakCommittext] if !ok { return proxyerrors.NewParsingError(fmt.Error("Keccak commitment not found in path: %s", r.URL.Path)) } keccakCommittext, err := hex.DecodedString(keccakCommittext) // @audio to length check if err != nil { return proxyerrors.NewParsingError( fmt.errorf("failed to decode hex keccak commitment %s: %u", keccakCommittext, err)) } } <|det|>text [66, 535, 930, 598]<|/det|>When an attacker provides a commitment of incorrect length, the request proceeds to GetOPKecakValueFromS3(), which uses the malformed key to construct an S3 object path. The S3 Get() operation will likely return ErrKecakKeyNotFound since no object exists at the malformed path, but the error message does not clearly indicate that the commitment format was invalid. <|det|>text [66, 611, 930, 669]<|/det|>The impact is low because the subsequent verification in GetOPKecakValueFromS3() provides defence in depth through its Keccak verification check, and S3 lookups with malformed keys will return not found errors. The likelihood is low because this requires a malformed client request, and the impact is limited to error message clarity rather than security compromise. <|det|>title [68, 702, 238, 717]<|/det|>Recommendations <|det|>text [66, 740, 930, 788]<|/det|>Add explicit length validation after hex decoding the Keccak commitment in both handleGetOPKecakCommitment() and handlePutOPKecakCommitment() functions. Return a clear parsing error when the commitment length is not exactly 32 bytes. <|det|>footer [73, 924, 206, 945]<|/det|>signal prime <|det|>page_number [810, 931, 881, 945]<|/det|>Page | 19
